en: Why is my attendance not showing?
hi: meri attendance kaise mark hoti hai
meri attendance show nahi ho rahi hai

answers.en: Attendance is recorded by the platform according to your learning activity and attendance flow. If your attendance does not appear correctly, please contact support.
answers.or: Platform ra learning activity au attendance flow anusare attendance record hue. Jadi attendance thik bhabare show na kare, support ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Platform aapki learning activity aur attendance flow ke according attendance record karta hai. Agar attendance sahi show nahi ho rahi hai, to support se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Platform learning activity au attendance flow anusare attendance record kare. Jadi attendance thik show heuni, support ku contact kara.

en: How does my attendance streak work?
How are consecutive attendance days counted?
How can I maintain my attendance streak?
or: mora attendance streak kemiti work kare
consecutive attendance days kemiti count hue
hi: meri attendance streak kaise work karti hai
consecutive attendance days kaise count hote hain
mixed: mora attendance streak kaise work kare
consecutive attendance days kemiti count hue

answers.en: An attendance streak counts consecutive days on which your attendance is recorded as Present.
answers.or: Attendance streak mane consecutive days jouthire tumara attendance Present bhabare record heithae, sehi days ra count.
answers.hi: Attendance streak un consecutive days ko count karta hai jin dinon mein aapki attendance Present ke roop mein record hoti hai.
answers.mixed: Attendance streak mane consecutive days ra count jouthire attendance Present bhabare record hue.

en: Can I get a badge for attendance?
What badges can I earn from attendance?
When do I get an attendance badge?
hi: kya attendance ke liye badge milta hai
attendance se kaun sa badge mil sakta hai
attendance badge kaise work karta hai

answers.en: Tech Monster awards attendance streak badges for qualifying consecutive Present days. The available milestones include 7, 11, 30 and 90 consecutive Present days.
answers.or: Qualifying consecutive Present days pain Tech Monster attendance streak badge award kare. Milestones hela 7, 11, 30 au 90 consecutive Present days.
answers.hi: Qualifying consecutive Present days ke liye Tech Monster attendance streak badges deta hai. Milestones 7, 11, 30 aur 90 consecutive Present days hain.
answers.mixed: Qualifying consecutive Present days pain Tech Monster attendance streak badges deithae. Milestones 7, 11, 30 au 90 days.
